meta.tier_focus: Security-team brief — full findings, remediation, TLS & header analysis, leaked-credential watch
meta.plan_blurb: Unlocks every critical and important finding with evidence and what to fix, adds TLS and header analysis, and watches the dark web for leaked credentials. Rescans this target four times a month.

findings.title: SQLi at /api/v1/users
findings.why: This weakness reduces the security posture of the asset and should be remediated to preserve defense-in-depth.
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements (or the ORM's bound-parameter API) for every query that consumes request input — never string-concatenate request input into SQL.
Validate and canonicalize the input server-side and reject non-conforming values before they reach the data layer.
Run the application's database account with least privilege (no DDL, no access to unrelated schemas).
findings.validation: Re-test the finding after the fix and confirm the weakness no longer reproduces.

findings.title: Reverse shell PoC in /upload
findings.what: File upload allows RCE; PoC included.
findings.why: This weakness reduces the security posture of the asset and should be remediated to preserve defense-in-depth.
findings.evidence: File upload allows RCE; PoC included.
remediation: Reject non-image MIME types and run the worker as a non-root user.
findings.validation: Re-test the finding after the fix and confirm the weakness no longer reproduces.

findings.title: GitHub PAT leaked in JS bundle
findings.why: This weakness reduces the security posture of the asset and should be remediated to preserve defense-in-depth.
remediation: Suppress or genericize framework banners and X-Powered-By style headers at the reverse proxy.
findings.validation: Re-test the finding after the fix and confirm the weakness no longer reproduces.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.why: This weakness reduces the security posture of the asset and should be remediated to preserve defense-in-depth.
remediation: Deploy a Content-Security-Policy that pins allowed script/style origins; start in Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, review reports, then enforce.
Add Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains once every endpoint is served over HTTPS.
Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.
findings.validation: Re-test the finding after the fix and confirm the weakness no longer reproduces.

findings.title: MySQL root password observed in CI script
findings.why: This weakness reduces the security posture of the asset and should be remediated to preserve defense-in-depth.
remediation: Context-encode all untrusted output (HTML/attribute/JS/URL) and prefer framework auto-escaping.
Deploy a Content-Security-Policy that pins allowed script origins as a second line of defense.
findings.validation: Re-test the finding after the fix and confirm the weakness no longer reproduces.

tls_analysis.summary: TLS posture could not be assessed for the scanned endpoint (no TLS data collected).

rows.detail: Strict-Transport-Security header not set (see headers section).

remediation: Terminate TLS in front of the service (reverse proxy or load balancer) and serve only TLS 1.2+ with an ECDHE/AEAD cipher suite.
Redirect HTTP to HTTPS and add HSTS once every endpoint is HTTPS-ready.
Automate certificate issuance and renewal; keep the chain current.

header_analysis.summary: Security-relevant response headers were not captured for this target; review is pending.

rows.recommended: Pin allowed script/style origins; report-only first, then enforce.
Deny unused browser features (geolocation, camera, etc.).
SAMEORIGIN — keep (or fold into CSP frame-ancestors).

dark_web.summary: Leaked-credential monitoring watches the target domain against breach and paste corpora and dark-web dumps. This run found no newly exposed credentials for the monitored domain. Monitoring continues between the four monthly rescans; counts only are shown here and full records are delivered to the security team through the evidence locker, never in plaintext in this document.

ai_conclusions.business_risk: Prioritise the critical and high-severity findings: together they represent the shortest path to account or data compromise, and the configuration gaps remove the defense-in-depth that would otherwise contain their impact.
prioritized_roadmap: Now — remediate every critical and high-severity finding.
This sprint — close the medium-severity configuration and transport gaps (TLS, security headers, rate limiting).
This quarter — publish the missing email-authentication and DNS-integrity records and move DMARC toward enforcement.
